annotations.title: Sourced token and wallet risk indicators with market facts

description: Combines the Base token-report risk tier and flags, available DEX market data, and wallet-audit risk tier, flags, account nonce, and native balance. Returns the underlying indicators separately; it does not generate buy/sell recommendations or calibrated confidence, and does not evaluate holder concentration. The account nonce is not full transaction, token-transfer, or trading history. Use as one input before a Base trade. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.

token.description: Token contract address on Base, 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex
